---
title: "Data-sharing procedure"
description: "Operational controls for preparing, approving, transferring and closing a non-public BNR data release."
manual-review-status: reviewed-by-irh
---

## Before preparation

Require a recorded, authorised decision that identifies:

- the approved purpose, people, population, period and variables;
- the access class and whether ethics approval is required;
- the applicable Data Sharing Agreement and signatories;
- storage, access, transfer, output-review, retention and destruction terms; and
- the BNR roles responsible for preparation, verification and release.

If any item is unclear, stop and refer it to the BNR Lead.

## Prepare the approved dataset

1. The **BNR Analyst** starts from the named controlled source and uses
   version-controlled preparation code.
2. Include only the approved records and variables and minimise indirect
   identifiers.
3. Assign an immutable dataset identity and produce a private preparation log,
   data dictionary and QA summary.
4. Apply the agreed deidentification and disclosure controls. The public
   **n < 6** rule does not by itself make record-level data safe or public.
5. Store the candidate and evidence in the authorised private location.

Never prepare a release by manually deleting cells from an exported copy.

## Verify and authorise release

An authorised reviewer confirms that the candidate matches the decision and
agreement, contains no unintended fields or records, passes QA and can be
transferred through the approved route. Record approval against the exact
dataset identity. A changed dataset requires renewed verification.

Technical access to a file does not confer approval authority.

## Transfer and record

1. Use only the BNR-approved secure transfer method.
2. Release only to the approved named recipients.
3. Record the exact dataset identity, sender, recipient, date and method in the
   private register.
4. Provide the data dictionary, permitted-use conditions and required return,
   retention or destruction dates.
5. Do not send non-public BNR data through personal email, public links or Git.

## Monitor and close

Track amendments, approved outputs, incidents, expiry, return and destruction.
Record closure and retain the request, decision, agreement, preparation and
transfer evidence according to the approved retention policy.

The [data-access request procedure](../../governance/data-access-requests.qmd)
is the gateway to this procedure.
